name: collab-docs
description: Application collaborative d'édition de documents en temps réel

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,realtime,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:realtime" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @collab/shared && npm run build -w @collab/api && npm run build -w @collab/realtime && npm run build -w @collab/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @collab/api && npm run lint -w @collab/realtime && npm run lint -w @collab/web
